lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as a grid of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately five vertical columns with three to five major centroids per column between the longitudinal ridges.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Prominent vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal carinae to form a series of nodes where the largest high-intensity blobs are centered.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible running from the gill region toward the posterior, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from high intensity on the dorsal edge to deep shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The primary pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small, high-luminance punctate features that are significantly smaller and more randomly distributed than the organized lateral flank grid.
